[[Lieutenant Greywind]] is getting reports of [[Charr]] activity in the [[Forsaken Tunnels]]. Venture deeper into the dungeon to ensure they do not threaten [[Ascalon]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Rendevouz{{sic}} with [[Adept Mullenix]].
* Take out [[Wyle Brimscourge]] and use the [[Dungeon Key|key]] to access the lower level.
* Take out the Charr patrols. [3...0] remain.
* Report to '''Lieutenant Greywind'''.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map). 

'''Level 1''': Fight your way south down the winding path towards the [[Dungeon Lock]]. The enemies you encounter will be the same as on your [[Long Thought Forgotten|last trip]] through this floor, except for the addition of some [[Shard Elemental]]s and [[Hulking Shard Elemental]]s near each patch of crystalline ground, which are just slightly stronger versions of the [[Cave Elemental]]s encountered previously. At the south end of the dungeon, there will be a large chamber with numerous [[Charr]], [[grawl]], and [[elemental]] foes, so [[pull]] carefully to avoid over-[[aggro]], and be mindful of two [[Charr Hunter]]s circling the perimeter. Wyle Brimscourge will also be patrolling the area, and although he is a high-level [[warrior]], he can be pulled and fought by himself, making him relatively simple to defeat. Time your most damaging abilities for when he uses [[Frenzy]] or [[Healing Signet]]. If you cannot withstand his attack damage, consider retreating up the slopes to the north to the edge of his following range, or using a [[pet]] or [[Fire Imp (summon)|fire imp]] to tank. Wyle will drop a [[Dungeon Key]], allowing you to open the lock and enter the portal to level 2.

'''Level 2''': Follow the passage down and east through some grawl, and as you turn to the north, you will see a vast chamber full of grawl and some patrolling Charr groups. Carefully cross to the north side of the chamber, pulling groups and keeping an eye on their patrol routes. Head for the western stairs on the north side, leading up to a room with more Shard Elementals and crystalline ground, then head directly north to encounter the first of three Charr patrols. Each patrol consists of one [[Charr Patrol Leader]] and a pair of [[Charr Patrol Stalker]]s. The stalkers are in a separate group and can easily be engaged separately from their leaders. Once you have killed this patrol, continue north past some more Shard Elementals to a passage leading to a crystal gate, where you will find the second patrol. Finally, head east past some [[Oakheart (Ascalon)|oakhearts]] and [[ironheart]]s to find the third patrol in the northeast corner of the dungeon. Once all three patrols are dead, map travel back to [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]] to claim the rewards.

{{anomaly|The Charr Patrol Leaders do not need to be killed to progress the quest. Only the Charr Patrol Stalkers are counted.}}

==Notes==
* The Charr Patrol Leaders start moving when they are approached, and will walk to a new location if they are left alone. The central leader moves northwest and stops at the entrance to the chamber filled with rock-crushing machines, the northern leader heads southeast through a tunnel filled with crystals and walks all the way to the middle of the large atrium chamber, and the northeastern leader merely steps out to the entrance of the tunnel he is found in.
* If any party members have not completed [[Long Thought Forgotten]], the western entrance to the dungeon will be closed, requiring the party to travel to the eastern entrance.
* The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten active in their quest log.
* Although this quest can be acquired without {{reforgedmode}} enabled, the quest NPCs will not spawn and the objectives will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.
** Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies spawning in the northern part of [[the Northlands]], making it significantly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
* By using the eastern dungeon entrance, running swiftly through the portal to level 2 when it is open, and moving very carefully on level 2, it is possible to complete this quest without fighting any Charr groups inside the dungeon except Wyle and the Charr Patrol Stalkers.
{{anomaly|The objective to rendezvous with Adept Mullenix completes immediately upon entering the Tunnels, even if the party uses the eastern entrance.}}

==Trivia==
* This quest was added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401|April 1st, 2026]] update.
* The name of this quest mimics the earlier quests [[Charr at the Gate]] and [[Charr in the Catacombs]].
* "just standing [...] Menacingly!" is likely a reference to a popular meme originating from episode "Hall Monitor" of [[w:SpongeBob SquarePants|SpongeBob SquarePants]]
